title: Share of the world's roadways by traffic side

source.name: Which side of the road do you drive on?

notes: Right-hand-traffic countries account for roughly 75% of the world's roadways, versus about 25% for left-hand-traffic countries -- a slightly bigger skew than the population split, since several large-land-area right-hand countries carry disproportionate road mileage. Figures approximate as widely compiled and reported.
